title: When Masking Helps or Hurts Robustness in Compressed CLIP: A Pre-Deployment Diagnostic
abstract: arXiv:2609.39704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper demonstrate that whether masking-based token pruning helps or hurts worst-group robustness can be predicted before deployment, without labels or fine-tuning. A systematic study of semantic masking across 8 spurious-correlation benchmarks shows its effect on worst-group accuracy is highly unstable: it improves accuracy by up to 82.5\% relative on some datasets and degrades it by up to 100\% on others. We trace this instability to spurious inversion: background patches receive higher CLIP text-similarity than the true object when the spurious attribute is background-separable, inverting the assumption every text- and attention-guided pruning method relies on. We introduce the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free, pre-deployment diagnostic whose sign predicts this effect with statistical significance (binomial $p=0.035$) across all 8 datasets, and remains dependable across 6 CLIP architectures with a clean foreground/b

translated_title: 掩码何时有助于或损害压缩CLIP的鲁棒性：一种部署前诊断方法
translated_abstract: 本文证明，基于掩码的token剪枝是有助于还是损害最差组鲁棒性，可以在部署之前进行预测，且无需标签或微调。通过对8个虚假相关性基准上语义掩码的系统性研究，我们发现其对最差组准确率的影响高度不稳定：在某些数据集上可相对提升准确率高达82.5%，而在其他数据集上则可能降低高达100%。我们将这种不稳定性归因于虚假反转现象：当虚假属性与背景可分离时，背景图像块获得的CLIP文本相似度反而高于真实目标，这颠倒了所有基于文本和注意力引导的剪枝方法所依赖的核心假设。我们提出了虚假反转度量（SIM），这是一种无标签的部署前诊断方法，其符号能够在所有8个数据集上以统计显著性（二项检验 p=0.035）预测这种效应，并且在6种具有干净前景/背景分离特性的CLIP架构上保持可靠。
tldr: 提出虚假反转度量（SIM）这一无需标签的部署前诊断指标，可预测掩码token剪枝在压缩CLIP中对最差组鲁棒性是有帮助还是有害。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Spurious Inversion Metric (SIM), a label-free pre-deployment diagnostic that predicts whether masking-based token pruning will help or hurt worst-group robustness in compressed CLIP.
